business_type: cyclical (commodity memory in an unprecedented HBM supercycle)
moat_source: three-player HBM oligopoly with sold-out capacity; evidence: record ~85% gross margin and 4x y/y revenue - but memory pricing power has always been cyclical, never permanent; the moat is the cycle, not the company

returns.assumption_note: Convergence to scenario IV by year 5, ~60% of the gap closed by year 3.

sensitivity_key_driver: 2027-2028 memory pricing (cycle normalization timing and depth)
primary_model_risk: Normalization assumption: base case assumes FCF roughly halves in the 2028 downcycle then recovers - the standard memory pattern. If HBM contracts have genuinely broken the cycle (bull case), IV approaches the current price; if the cycle is merely delayed and deeper (bear case), 85% gross margins mean the supply response now building is enormous.
expectations_gap_key_variable: cycle permanence: at ~8x annualized forward EPS the market is NOT paying peak multiples - it is explicitly pricing normalization, as are we; the disagreement is only about depth, which is why the -22% drawdown from the high coexists with quadrupling revenue
top_5_bull_arguments: FQ4 guide of ~$50B revenue / ~$31 EPS means earnings are still accelerating - the peak is not yet visible in the data
HBM is a three-player oligopoly, sold out, with AI demand structurally growing - this cycle may genuinely differ
~8x annualized forward EPS and 22.3x trailing is not euphoric pricing
Record ~85% gross margin generates cash fast enough to bulletproof the balance sheet before any downturn (grade A)
Reported AI-lab demand (Anthropic-related) suggests contracted, not spot, revenue mix
top_5_bear_arguments: 85% gross margin in a commodity industry is the strongest mean-reversion signal that exists in semiconductors
Expected IV ($494.50) sits ~46% below the price even weighting the bull case at 25%
Peak-EPS multiples are the classic memory value trap - cheap on the wrong E (value_trap rated High)
Industry supply response to these margins is inevitable and arrives 2027-2028 regardless of demand
-14.9% week on sector sentiment alone shows how fast the multiple goes when the tape turns (beta 2.14)
thesis_breakers: First sequential DRAM/HBM price decline reported or guided
FQ1 2027 guidance below FQ4 2026 actuals (sequential revenue decline)
Samsung or SK hynix announcing major greenfield capacity beyond current plans
HBM contract renegotiations or cancellations by AI labs/hyperscalers
position_size_recommendation: 0% new money at $912.77; existing holders should recognize these as peak-cycle economics - the DCF-based accumulation zone is below ~$495
notes_on_nulls: ROIC/ROE/ROA null: not captured as sourced ratios.
